kind.description:
Kind is "failure" (a run that failed, needs a sign-in, or was skipped
or missed) or "app" (about the app, e.g. an update).

routine.description: Routine and Run (a run ID, as in `runs show`) are what it's about, if any.

hook.description: Hook is true when Routine names a hook, not a routine.

deliveredAt.description: DeliveredAt is when a frontend showed it; absent until then.

items.description: Notification is one thing to tell me.
